Sydney, Nova Scotia
 Marquee letter rentals for Cape Breton's big moments
 CB Marquee Characters rents big, white, light-up marquee letters (3 feet tall) and numbers (4 feet tall) for weddings, birthdays and events in Sydney and across Cape Breton, Nova Scotia. Rental is $45 per character for up to 4 days, plus $25 for delivery, set-up and pick-up in the Sydney area. You decide what they say.

## What we need from you

 Event planning comes with enough stress already, so we keep this part simple.

 - 

### A regular outlet

 That's it. No special wiring needed.

 - 

### A safe, flat surface

 Indoors or outdoors both work.

 - 

### A bit of space

 Plan on about 2 feet of width for each letter.

 - 

### An extension cord

 Only if the outlet is far away. Let us know and we can bring one.

 We take care of delivery, set-up and takedown. From backyards to banquet halls, we've set up just about everywhere.

 Service area

## Where we deliver in Cape Breton

 CB Marquee Characters is based in Sydney, Nova Scotia and delivers across the Cape Breton Regional Municipality: Sydney, Glace Bay, North Sydney, Sydney Mines, New Waterford, Membertou, Westmount, Coxheath and Howie Centre. Delivery, set-up and pick-up is $25 in the Sydney area. For Baddeck, Louisbourg, Port Hawkesbury and the rest of Cape Breton Island, tell us where the event is and we'll include delivery in your written quote.

 Questions

## Marquee letter rental FAQ

### How much does it cost to rent marquee letters in Cape Breton?

 Letters and numbers from CB Marquee Characters cost $45 per character plus HST, for up to 4 days. E, K, M, Q, S, V, X and the numbers 0 and 1 are $50, and the ampersand is $55. Delivery, set-up and pick-up add $25 in the Sydney area, so LOVE comes to $215 plus HST all in.

### What is included in a marquee letter rental?

 Every rental includes the characters you choose, delivery to your venue, set-up, and pick-up after the event, for up to 4 days at one flat price. You provide a regular outlet and a safe, flat spot. HST is extra, a 25% non-refundable deposit holds your date, and you get a written quote before anything is booked.

### How big are the letters and numbers?

 Letters stand 3 feet tall and about 2 feet wide. Numbers stand 4 feet tall. All are painted white, fitted with warm bulbs, and need about 2 feet of width each.

### Can the letters be set up outdoors?

 Yes. The letters work indoors or outdoors on a safe, flat surface with a regular outlet nearby. We have set them up in backyards, on the Port of Sydney boardwalk and at the Wentworth Park band shell.

### Where does CB Marquee Characters deliver?

 We are based in Sydney, Nova Scotia and deliver across the Cape Breton Regional Municipality, including Glace Bay, North Sydney, Sydney Mines, New Waterford, Membertou, Westmount and Coxheath. Delivery is $25 in the Sydney area. For Baddeck, Louisbourg, Port Hawkesbury and elsewhere on Cape Breton Island, tell us the venue and we will include delivery in your written quote.

### What can the letters spell?

 We rent letters, numbers and an ampersand, so a name, an age, a year or a word like LOVE or MR & MRS all work. Tell us what you want to spell and your date, and we will confirm every character is available. Popular dates go early, so it is worth asking as soon as you know.

### How do I book the letters?

 Call 902-537-1074, message us on Facebook or Instagram, or email admin@cbmarqueecharacters.ca with your word, your date and the venue. You will get a written quote before anything is booked, and you will be talking to the person who built the letters.

 Planning guide

## How to plan light-up letters for an event in Cape Breton

 Written by Nicholas Driscoll, owner of CB Marquee Characters. Updated October 2026.
 Most people book the letters two to six weeks before the event, and the planning takes about ten minutes. Here is the order we walk through on every quote, with the numbers you need.

 - 

### Pick the word and count the characters

 Every letter and number is $45, except E, K, M, Q, S, V, X, 0 and 1 at $50, and the ampersand at $55. Spaces are free. LOVE is 4 characters, MR & MRS is 6, HAPPY BIRTHDAY is 13, and a two-digit age is 2. Send us the exact spelling and we will confirm every character is available for your date.

 - 

### Measure the space

 Letters stand 3 feet tall and need about 2 feet of width each, so LOVE takes roughly 8 feet of wall or lawn. Numbers stand 4 feet tall. Leave a foot of clearance on each side so people can stand beside the word for photos.

 - 

### Find the outlet

 The bulbs run from one regular household outlet, with no special wiring. If the outlet is more than a few metres away, tell us and we will bring an extension cord. One outlet is enough for a full word.

 - 

### Choose a flat, safe spot, indoors or out

 The letters sit on any flat surface: a banquet-hall stage, a backyard deck, the Port of Sydney boardwalk or the band shell at Wentworth Park have all worked. Outdoors, keep them off soft ground and away from standing water so the bases stay level.

 - 

### Think about the photo

 Place the word where the camera will point: behind the head table, beside the cake, at the entrance or at the dance floor edge. The letters read well lit and unlit, so daytime ceremonies and evening receptions both work. The warm bulbs photograph best once the room lights come down.

 - 

### Book the time window

 Each rental covers up to 4 days at one flat price, so a Friday set-up for a Saturday wedding costs the same as a single night. We deliver and set up before guests arrive and pick up after the event ends or on an agreed day after. Delivery, set-up and pick-up are included for $25 in the Sydney area, and quoted for the rest of Cape Breton Island.

 - 

### Confirm the budget

 LOVE is $215 plus HST. MR & MRS is $320 plus HST. A two-digit birthday age is $115 to $125 plus HST. HAPPY BIRTHDAY is $610 plus HST. A 25% non-refundable deposit holds your date. You get the written quote first, and nothing is booked until you say yes.

## About CB Marquee Characters

 CB Marquee Characters is a marquee letter rental business in Sydney, Nova Scotia. The 3-foot letters and 4-foot numbers are built and painted by hand in Sydney, and the person who built them is the person who delivers and sets them up at your event.
